beats.text: AI is writing more code than ever. So why are software job postings going up?
beats.dir: gripping, puzzled hook; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: Indeed's job data shows US software postings rising again since mid-2025.
beats.dir: factual, quick; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: But look at who they're hiring.
beats.dir: conspiratorial lean-in; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: Seventy-one percent of the growth came from senior roles.
beats.dir: punchy reveal; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: And over a third came from jobs with AI in the title.
beats.dir: punchy reveal; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: Meanwhile, total postings are still about a quarter below pre-pandemic levels.
So the market isn't dead. It's picky.
beats.dir: confident, memorable; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: The fastest way in? Show you can build with AI, not just next to it.
beats.dir: helpful, energetic payoff; clear pause between sentences
